svg.title: Eleanor's family caregiving
svg.desc: Arthur (1940–2019) and Eleanor (84, dementia and daily care needs) are the parents of Dana and Paul, with only Eleanor and index person Dana inside the dashed shared household. Dana provides daily personal care and is exhausted without regular respite; Paul lives separately and provides weekly transport, with two-line support arcs to Eleanor and a labelled zigzag conflict over unequal care workload.
